model: twisted/blunt: parent + rounded caps at both tips (right cap mirrored to the left)

parent_preserved.note: each parent B-spline face's poles compared with parent.step; the two planar attachment faces are replaced by the caps

locked_dimensions.silhouette_note: the lip is symmetric about the parent's mid surface; near the trailing edge the locked rim lies up to 0.091 mm below that mid surface, so the lip apex (plan silhouette) sits slightly outboard of the rim
